exposure: Kangaroo mother care (KMC) less than 3 times per day
Kangaroo mother care (KMC) 3 times or more per day
outcome: Postpartum depression (measured using the Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale)
cohort: 60 mothers of premature infants hospitalised in a neonatal intensive care unit who gave birth via caesarean section and carried out KMC
finding: Mothers who performed KMC more frequently (3 times or more per day) had a greater decrease in postpartum depression scores over the 30-day follow-up period.
